long_run_resume.evidence: Concurrent USB gadget reinitialization; same boot ID and no new tombstone. Remote shell stderr from the failed fixture was not retained, so root cause is not proved.

functional.kernel_log_note: The retained log shows recurrent enable_irq from dwc3_msm USB resume; ring wrap prevents claiming zero warning events for the full run.

notes: Received throughput uses complete ready-to-exit time, including final drain, host control overhead and detach.
Previous natural-scheduler summary/ADB report has no ready-to-exit timing; compare its loss counts or target hit rates only.
Paired controlled runs use the same CPU4 target, CPU5 tracer, 1.92GHz cluster and 6 million dynamic instructions per sample, three repeats.
Natural runs use 24 million dynamic instructions per sample; performance depends on scheduler/frequency/load.
Output schema, register delta/checkpoint/loss recovery semantics and 32MiB ring size are unchanged.
CPU ticks/context switches cover the sampled target interval rather than complete drain.
Both kernels use the already validated runtime UXN image; no kernel flash or source change in this optimization.
